item.description:
• Kit speaks about you as you, not as "he": your own name, and neutral pronouns until you say otherwise.
  • Postcards, handoffs and reflections are addressed to you by name.
  • The People lens draws its names from your own memories.
  • Care signals stay quiet until you have set a Telegram chat for them, and say so plainly when you have not.
  • Build requests over Telegram use the code folder you configure, or decline instead of guessing.
